title: Integrating metabolomics, network pharmacology and molecular dynamics simulations reveals that Xiehuang San targets CLCF1-STAT3 to restore insulin signaling in T2DM.
authors: Lin, Jiayi; Sun, Yu; Pan, Yukun; Liu, Huimin; Gao, Yue; Lv, Shuyi; Li, Yangyang; Song, Lili; Li, Yubo
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合代谢组学、网络药理学和分子动力学模拟探究泻黄散通过CLCF1-STAT3通路改善T2DM胰岛素信号，但核心是中药药理与代谢疾病，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Xiehuang San (XHS) is a classical Chinese herbal formula with analgesic, anti-inflammatory, gastrointestinal-regulating and hypoglycemic effects, but its specific regulatory mechanisms remain incompletely understood. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the effects of XHS on T2DM, with a particular focus on its metabolic and molecular mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: C57BL/6J mice were induced with T2DM using a high-fat diet combined with streptozotocin. T2DM mice were treated with XHS for 4 weeks to assess blood glucose control and metabolism. Serum metabolomics were analyzed by UPLC-Q-TOF/MS. Network pharmacology integrated drug-metabolite-disease associations. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations assessed the binding of active compounds to targets. RT-qPCR and Western blot were used to determine gene and protein expression levels. An in vitro model was established to validate the effects of XHS on T2DM. RESULTS: XHS significantly improved T2DM pathology. Compared to the diabetic Mod group, XHS reduced fasting blood glucose levels, enhances glucose tolerance and improves insulin resistance and sensitivity. 24 dysregulated metabolites were corrected after treatment. Network pharmacology predicted that the key target of XHS in T2DM treatment is the CLCF1-STAT3 pathway. Licochalcone B, Wogonin and Apigenin are predicted to exhibit strong binding affinity for this pathway. Both in vitro and in vivo models, XHS effectively inhibits the activation of the CLCF1-STAT3 signalling pathway and protects insulin signalling. CONCLUSION: This study combines metabolomics and network pharmacology to reveal that XHS exerts anti-diabetic effects by remodeling glycerophospholipid metabolism and inhibiting CLCF1-STAT3 signaling. These findings support the application of XHS in the treatment of T2DM.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：泻黄散（XHS）是一种经典中药复方，具有镇痛、抗炎、调节胃肠功能和降血糖作用，但其具体调控机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：评估XHS对2型糖尿病（T2DM）的作用，特别关注其代谢和分子机制。材料与方法：采用高脂饮食联合链脲佐菌素诱导C57BL/6J小鼠建立T2DM模型。T2DM小鼠经XHS治疗4周，评估血糖控制和代谢情况。通过UPLC-Q-TOF/MS分析血清代谢组学。网络药理学整合药物-代谢物-疾病关联。分子对接和动力学模拟评估活性化合物与靶点的结合。采用RT-qPCR和Western blot测定基因和蛋白表达水平。建立体外模型验证XHS对T2DM的作用。结果：XHS显著改善T2DM病理状态。与糖尿病Mod组相比，XHS降低空腹血糖水平，增强葡萄糖耐量，并改善胰岛素抵抗和敏感性。治疗后24个失调代谢物得到纠正。网络药理学预测XHS治疗T2DM的关键靶点为CLCF1-STAT3通路。甘草查尔酮B、汉黄芩素和芹菜素被预测对该通路表现出强结合亲和力。在体外和体内模型中，XHS有效抑制CLCF1-STAT3信号通路的激活，并保护胰岛素信号。结论：本研究结合代谢组学和网络药理学揭示，XHS通过重塑甘油磷脂代谢和抑制CLCF1-STAT3信号发挥抗糖尿病作用。这些发现支持XHS在T2DM治疗中的应用。
